def: to beatify, i.e. pronounce (or esteem) fortunate

occurrences.text: For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.
Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
